4. Functional relationships
DoorStateManager publishes If_DoorState to CentralLockingManager and CabinLightingManager.
CentralLockingManager inhibits auto-lock when any door state is OPEN or UNKNOWN. CabinLightingManager
commands 100% courtesy lighting when a door transitions from CLOSED to OPEN.
5. Controlled inconsistency
The component is named CabinLightingManager in the component inventory but is intentionally called CabinLightManager in the
maintenance note below. The mismatch is included for terminology-consistency evaluation.
5.1 Maintenance note
CabinLightManager shall be inspected when CabinLightLevel_pct remains above 20% for more than 60 seconds after
all doors are closed.
6. Review limitations
No physical pin mapping or network frame mapping is represented. Findings require engineer review.
